clips.title: The story
paras: Marshal Marris is the beleaguered military officer commanding the town watch at Lakeshire. Stationed near the town's bridge, he coordinates defense operations against the massive Blackrock orc invasion pressing down from the heights of the Redridge Mountains. With Stormwind's army absent, he relies on visiting adventurers to blunt the horde's advances.

Lakeshire stands on the brink of collapse, caught between the gnolls to the west and the terrifying military might of the Blackrock clan to the east. Marshal Marris oversees the guard line at the town's primary bridge, but his resources are depleted and his soldiers are spread impossibly thin. With the kingdom of Stormwind withholding royal reinforcements, Marris carries the heavy burden of keeping the township from being overwhelmed by brute force.

Recognizing that defense alone will not save Redridge, Marris orchestrates decisive offensive strikes against the orc encampments. He directs mercenaries to cull the Blackrock warriors, dismantle their shadowcasters, and ultimately hunt down Tharil'zun, the menacing commander entrenched inside the ruins of Stonewatch Keep. His orders aim to break the command structure of the orcs before an all-out assault crushes Lakeshire completely.
